```{r}
fig2_df <- make_proportions(

baseline <- fig2_df$percentage[which(fig2_df$condition == "Passive\ncontrol\n")]
```

## primary analysis
### question 1
Does informing patients that they are at high risk for flu and flu-related complications increase the likelihood that they will get vaccinated?

#### 1a
```{r}

#versions that received high-risk messages
risk_messages <- c("unspecified","medrec","algorithm")

#binary variable - high risk vs. baseline
analysis_data$risk_messages <- ifelse(
  analysis_data$algo_condition %in% 
    risk_messages, 1, 0)

#making sure 0 is nocontact or contact control
addmargins(table(analysis_data$algo_condition,analysis_data$risk_messages))

#1a is high risk vs. contact control, excluding no contact
analysis1a <- lm(vaccinated ~ risk_messages, data = analysis_data, 
                 subset = algo_condition != "nocontact")
summary(analysis1a)

tab_model(analysis1a, show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, digits = 3,
          title = "Analysis 1a: High Risk vs. Contact Control",
          col.order = c("est", "ci", "df.error", 
                        "stat", "p"))

analysis_data %>%
  subset(algo_condition != "nocontact") %>%
  group_by(risk_messages) %>%
  summarize(meanvax = mean(vaccinated))

analysis_data %>%
  subset(algo_condition != "nocontact") %>%
  group_by(risk_messages) %>%
  tally()

#robustness check - robust SEs
summ(analysis1a, robust = "HC1", confint = TRUE, digits = 3)


```

#### 1b
```{r}

#1b is high risk vs. no-contact control, excluding contact control
analysis1b <- lm(vaccinated ~ risk_messages, data = analysis_data, 
                 subset = algo_condition != "control")
summary(analysis1b)

tab_model(analysis1b, show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, digits = 3, 
          title = "Analysis 1b: High Risk vs. No-Contact Control",
          col.order = c("est", "ci", "df.error", 
                        "stat", "p"))


analysis_data %>%
  subset(algo_condition != "control") %>%
  group_by(risk_messages) %>%
  summarize(meanvax = mean(vaccinated))


#robustness check - robust SEs
summ(analysis1b, robust = "HC1", confint = TRUE, digits = 3)

  
```


### question 2
Are flu shot messages more effective when they include reasons why (i.e., a medical records review or AI/ML-based review, along with personalized contributing risk factors) patients were designated as high risk for flu and flu-related complications?
```{r}

#list the conditions with reasons
reasons <- c("medrec","algorithm")


# make "reasons" variable
analysis_data$reasons <- ifelse(analysis_data$algo_condition %in% 
                                    reasons, 1, 0)


#analysis 2 is only comparing reasons arms to unspecified, so removing both 
#control groups from the analysis
analysis2 <- lm(vaccinated ~ reasons, data = analysis_data, 
                subset = !algo_condition %in% c("nocontact","control"))
summary(analysis2)

tab_model(analysis2, show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, digits = 3,
          title = "Analysis 2: Reasons vs. No Reasons",
          col.order = c("est", "ci", "df.error", 
                        "stat", "p"))

analysis_data %>%
  subset(!algo_condition %in% c("nocontact","control")) %>%
  group_by(reasons) %>%
  summarize(meanvax = mean(vaccinated))

analysis_data %>%
  subset(!algo_condition %in% c("nocontact","control")) %>%
  group_by(reasons) %>%
  tally()


```


### question 3
Do messages encouraging flu shots increase flu vaccination rates?
```{r}

#making another binary variable with only contact control = 1
analysis_data$contactcontrol <- as.factor(ifelse(
  analysis_data$algo_condition == "control", 1, 0))


#including only contact and no-contact control in this analysis
analysis3 <- lm(vaccinated ~ contactcontrol, data = analysis_data, 
                subset = algo_condition %in% c("nocontact","control"))
summary(analysis3)

tab_model(analysis3, show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, digits = 3,
          title = "Analysis 3: Contact Control vs. No-Contact Control",
          col.order = c("est", "ci", "df.error", 
                        "stat", "p"))

#robustness check w/robust SEs
summ(analysis3, robust = "HC1", confint = TRUE, digits = 3)


```

#### does it matter if you give one or three reasons?
#### condition x number of reasons interaction
```{r}

#algo x reasons interaction
algoXreasons <- lm(vaccinated ~ algo_condition * num_reasons, 
                   data = analysis_data,
                   subset = algo_condition %in% c("medrec","algorithm"))

summary(algoXreasons)

tab_model(algoXreasons,show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, digits = 3,
          col.order  = c("est", "ci", "df.error", 
                        "stat", "p"))


```

#### plot number of reasons by condition
```{r}
analysis_data$num_reasons_2 <- ifelse(
  analysis_data$algo_condition == "unspecified", "0reasons",
  as.character(analysis_data$num_reasons)) 


table(analysis_data$num_reasons_2, analysis_data$num_reasons, useNA = "always")

analysis_data$num_reasons_2 <- str_replace(analysis_data$num_reasons_2,
                                           "reason", " Reason")


reasons_plot <- analysis_data %>%
  subset(!is.na(num_reasons_2)) %>%
  group_by(algo_condition_plot, num_reasons_2, vaccinated) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "vaccinated", 
              values_from = "n", 
              names_prefix = "vaccinated_") %>%
  mutate(total_n = vaccinated_0 + vaccinated_1, 
         prop_vaxxed = vaccinated_1/total_n,
         perc = prop_vaxxed * 100,
         se = sep(prop_vaxxed, total_n),
         ci = se * 1.96,
         perc_se = se * 100, 
         perc_ci = ci * 100,
         percentage = paste0(round(perc, 1),"%"))

reasons_plot$condition_rev <- fct_rev(reasons_plot$algo_condition_plot)

reasons_plot$perc_change <- (reasons_plot$prop_vaxxed - baseline_prop) * 100

reasons_plot$change <- reasons_plot$perc - (baseline_prop *100)

reasons_plot$perc_change <- paste0(format(round(reasons_plot$change,1),nsmall = 1),"%")


reasons_plot$condition_rev2 <- factor(
  reasons_plot$condition_rev,
  levels = c("High risk\nalgorithm\n+ reasons","High risk\nmedical records\n+ reasons","High risk\nonly\n","Active\ncontrol\n","Passive\ncontrol\n"),
  labels = c("High risk\nalgorithm\n+ reasons","High risk\nmedical records\n+ reasons","High risk\nonly","Active control","Passive control"))
reasons_plot$condition_rev2 <- droplevels(reasons_plot$condition_rev2)
reasons_plot$condition_rev2 <- fct_rev(reasons_plot$condition_rev2)


reasons_plot$num_reasons_2 <- factor(reasons_plot$num_reasons_2, levels = c("3 Reasons","1 Reason","0 Reasons")) 
reasons_plot$baseline_lab2 <- ifelse(
  reasons_plot$condition_rev2 == "High risk\nmedical records\n+ reasons", paste0("Passive control:<br>", baseline," vaccinated"),"")

```

### question 4
Among messages that mention patients’ risk statuses, is it most effective to a) give patients no information about how their risk status was determined (group 3), b) tell patients their high-risk designation was based on a review of their medical records with personalized reasons for their risk determination (group 4), or c) tell patients their high-risk designation was based on a computer algorithm review of their records with personalized reasons for their risk determination (group 5)?
```{r}

#make a new variable called high_risk_cond that is the same as algo_cond but it's only populated for the high risk conditions
analysis_data$high_risk_cond <- ifelse(
  !analysis_data$algo_condition %in% 
    c("nocontact","control"), analysis_data$algo_condition, NA)

table(analysis_data[,c("algo_condition","high_risk_cond")], useNA = "always")

#name the levels
analysis_data$high_risk_cond <- factor(
  analysis_data$high_risk_cond,
  levels = c(3,4,5),
  labels = c("unspecified","medrec","algorithm"))

table(analysis_data[,c("algo_condition","high_risk_cond")], useNA = "always")

levels(analysis_data$high_risk_cond)

#regression
analysis4 <- lm(vaccinated ~ high_risk_cond, data = analysis_data, 
                subset = !algo_condition %in% c("nocontact","control"))
summary(analysis4)

tab_model(analysis4, show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, 
          title = "Analysis 4: Comparing High-Risk Messages")

pairs(emmeans(analysis4, "high_risk_cond"), infer = TRUE)



a4glm <- glm(vaccinated~high_risk_cond, data = analysis_data,
    subset = !algo_condition %in% c("nocontact","control"), family = "binomial")

summary(a4glm)

tab_model(a4glm)

```

### risk level * messages interaction 
```{r}

#1a is high risk vs. contact control, excluding no contact
analysis1a_risk <- lm(vaccinated ~ risk_messages * risk_condition, 
                      data = analysis_data, 
                 subset = algo_condition != "nocontact")
summary(analysis1a_risk)

tab_model(analysis1a_risk,  show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, digits = 3,
          title = "High Risk vs. Active Control * Risk condition",
           col.order = c("est", "ci", "df.error", 
                        "stat", "p"))

emm <- emmeans(analysis1a_risk, ~ risk_messages | risk_condition)
contrasts <- contrast(emm, method = "pairwise", infer = TRUE)
summary(contrasts)

#1b is high risk vs. no-contact control, excluding contact control
analysis1b_risk <- lm(vaccinated ~ risk_messages * risk_condition, 
                      data = analysis_data, 
                 subset = algo_condition != "control")
summary(analysis1b_risk)

tab_model(analysis1b_risk,  show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, digits = 3,
          title = "High Risk vs. No-Contact Control * Risk condition",
```

## Race
```{r}

analysis_data$race <- factor(
  analysis_data$race, 
  levels = c("American Indian Or Alaska Native","Asian",
             "Native Hawaiian Or Other Pacific Islander",
             "Black Or African American","White",
             "More Than One Race","Unknown"))


analysis_data$vaccinated_str <- factor(
  analysis_data$vaccinated, 
  levels = c(0,1),
  labels = c("not_vaccinated","vaccinated"))


analysis_data %>%
  group_by(race, algo_condition_plot, vaccinated_str) %>%
  tally() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(race, algo_condition_plot), 
              names_from = vaccinated_str, values_from = n) %>%
  mutate(total_n = sum(not_vaccinated, vaccinated, na.rm = TRUE),
         prop_vaccinated = round(vaccinated/total_n, 3)) %>%
  #replace_na(list(total_n = 0, prop_vaccinated = 0))%>%
  mutate(value = paste0(prop_vaccinated, "<br> n = ", total_n)) %>%
  select(race, algo_condition_plot, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = race, names_from = algo_condition_plot, 
              values_from = value) %>%
  #replace_na(list(`High risk\nmedical records` = "0<br> n = 0")) %>%
  rename(Race = race) %>%
  formattable()


```

```{r}
summary(analysis1a_pcp)

tab_model(analysis1a_pcp, show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, digits = 3,
          col.order = c("est", "ci", "df.error", 
                        "stat", "p"))

#1b is high risk vs. passive control, excluding active control
analysis1b_pcp <- lm(vaccinated ~ risk_messages + geis_pcp, data = analysis_data, 
                 subset = algo_condition != "control")
summary(analysis1b_pcp)

tab_model(analysis1b_pcp, show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, digits = 3,
          col.order = c("est", "ci", "df.error", 
                        "stat", "p"))

```

#### high risk differences
```{r}

#regression
analysis4_4weeks <- lm(vaccinated_4weeks ~ high_risk_cond, data = analysis_data, 
                subset = !algo_condition %in% c("nocontact","control"))
summary(analysis4_4weeks)

tab_model(analysis4_4weeks, show.stat = TRUE, show.df = TRUE, 
          title = "Analysis 4: Comparing High-Risk Messages")

x <- data.frame(pairs(emmeans(analysis4_4weeks, "high_risk_cond"), infer = TRUE))

#pattern for reporting
paste0(
  x$contrast,": b = ",round(x$estimate, 3), 
  ", [95% CI: ",round(x$lower.CL,3),", ",round(x$upper.CL,3),
  "], t(",x$df,") = ",round(x$t.ratio,3), ", p = ", round(x$p.value,3))
```

```{r}

vax_source_analysis <- analysis_data %>% 
  group_by(algo_condition) %>% 
  summarize(EHR_data = sum(vax_source == "EHR_data", na.rm = TRUE),
            Non_EHR_data = sum(vax_source == "Non_EHR_data", na.rm = TRUE),
            n = EHR_data + Non_EHR_data)

prop.test(vax_source_analysis$EHR_data, vax_source_analysis$n)



analysis_data %>%
  group_by(algo_condition_plot) %>%
  summarize(
    `Vaccinated: EHR data` = paste0(
      format(round(mean(vax_source == "EHR_data", na.rm = TRUE)*100,1),nsmall = 1),
      "% (",sum(vax_source == "EHR_data", na.rm = TRUE),")"),
    `Vaccinated: Non-EHR data` = paste0(
      format(round(mean(vax_source == "Non_EHR_data", na.rm = TRUE)*100,1),nsmall = 1),
      "% (",sum(vax_source == "Non_EHR_data", na.rm = TRUE),")"),
    `Not Vaccinated` = paste0(
      format(round(mean(is.na(vax_source))*100,1),nsmall = 1),
      "% (",sum(is.na(vax_source)),")"),
    `Total N` = n()
    )%>%
  t() %>% 
  kbl(caption = "Study 2 analysis sample") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE)
```
